initial_population: the three development points and 29 Latin-hypercube points drawn with the seed of the run

generation_chunks.seed_of_chunk: seed + chunk index, the first chunk has index 0

validation_checks.candidate: population member with the lowest training cost

endpoint: checked candidate with the lowest validation cost up to the stop
selected_model: endpoint with the lowest validation cost over the seeds; an exact tie goes to the earlier generation and then to the lower seed number
early_rejection: the evaluation of a trial stops when its partial cost over the training motions already exceeds the cost of the population member it would replace; the search path is unchanged
